item.title: WMCHC’s Rebecca Lalley receives Innovation Award at state level
item.description: Rebecca Lalley, LPN, clinical coordinator/office supervisor at the Honesdale Family Health Center, received the 2025 Innovation Award from the Pennsylvania Association of Community Health Centers (PACHC). The Awards for Primary Care Excellence (APEX) ceremony was held during PACHC’s annual Conference and Clinical Summit in Lancaster. item.title: COUNTERPOINT: Americans know Trump is wrong
item.description: President Donald Trump is the consummate salesman, and his State of the Union address will certainly seek to convince Americans that our republic is in a better place.

item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL: Delaware Valley set for District 2-4 Class 6A semifinals
item.description: There are still two places remaining to fill at Mohegan Arena for championship weekend. The District 2-4 Class 6A semifinals will be played Monday night. Third-seeded Delaware Valley (15-8) travels to No. 2 Williamsport (13-10) at 6 p.m. In the other semifinal, No. 4 Hazleton Area (12-11) is at top-seeded Wilkes-Barre Area (13-9) at 7 p.m. The winners will close out the three days of finals Saturday at 8 p.m. Delaware Valley is seeking its first trip to the arena for a championship final. item.title: Ruth’s Chris Golf Classic makes record-breaking donation to Dinners for Kids
item.description: Ruth’s Chris Steak House and Metz Culinary Management Inc. recently presented a record-breaking $92,466.50, raised through the ninth annual Ruth’s Chris Golf Classic this past September, to local nonprofit Dinners for Kids. The event was held at Huntsville Golf Club and once again brought together community members, Metz partners and generous sponsors for a day of impact and camaraderie. item.title: POINT: Trump is making America boom again
item.description: One year ago, Donald Trump returned to office with four clear priorities: secure the border, lower costs for working-class Americans, restore economic growth and put good-paying American jobs first.
